brightness.docs:
**int**: A brightness value in the range 0-255

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The chip select pin.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

data_rate.docs:
**int**: Set the data rate of the SPI interface to the display. One of `80MHz`, `40MHz`, `20MHz`, `10MHz` (default), `5MHz`, `2MHz` or `1MHz`.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

height.docs:
**int**: Specifies height of display in pixels.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

offset_height.docs:
**int**: Specify an offset for the y-direction of the display. Default is 0.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

offset_width.docs:
**int**: Specify an offset for the x-direction of the display, typically used when a display is smaller than the maximum supported by the driver chip. Default is 0

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

width.docs:
**int**: Specifies width of display.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

dimensions.docs:
Dimensions of the screen, specified either as *width* **x** *height* (e.g `320x240`  ) or with separate config keys.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

draw_from_origin.docs:
**boolean**: When set, all partial display updates will start at the origin (0,0). Defaults to false.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

enable_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The display enable pin.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

init_sequence.docs:
**A list of byte arrays**: Specifies the init sequence for the display. This is required when using the `CUSTOM` model - but may be empty. If specified for other models this data will be sent after the pre-configured sequence.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

spi_mode.docs:
Set the mode for the SPI interface to the display. Default is `MODE0`.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

color_order.docs:
Should be one of `rgb` (default) or `bgr`.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

draw_rounding.docs:
**int**: Caters for display chips that require partial drawing to be aligned to certain boundaries. Default is 2, must be a power of 2.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

invert_colors.docs:
**boolean**: With this boolean option you can invert the display colors.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

mirror_x.docs:
**boolean**: If true, mirror the x axis.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

mirror_y.docs:
**boolean**: If true, mirror the y axis.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

transform.docs:
Transform the display presentation using hardware. All defaults are `false`. This option cannot be used with `rotation`.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `5s`.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

auto_clear_enabled.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to automatically clear the display data before each lambda call, or to keep the existing display content (must overwrite explicitly, e.g., only on data change). Defaults to `true` if a lambda or pages are configured, false otherwise.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

pages.docs:
**list**: Show pages instead of a single lambda. See [Display Pages](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-pages).

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

rotation.docs:
Rotate the display presentation in software. Choose one of `0°`, `90°`, `180°`, or `270°`.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the display. See [Display Rendering Engine](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-engine) for more information.

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*

*See also: [Quad SPI Displays](https://esphome.io/components/display/qspi_dbi#configuration-variables)*
